svg.title: Amaan - Engineering Student at MGIT Hyderabad
svg.desc: Animated profile card: a glowing rainbow border, typing tagline, and a boy coding on a computer at night.
svg.text: Not too easy to find someone like me ..
Curiosity dives into me when an error occurs.
Current Mission: Automating my entire digital existence
Trying to solve my own problems by creating them ..
